input: Write a due diligence memo on Canva

output.company: Canva (Canva, Inc. / Canva Pty Ltd group; Sydney-headquartered design and visual-communication platform)

business.claim: Australian software company, founded in Perth on 1 January 2013 and headquartered in Sydney. In February 2023 it reorganized so that Canva, Inc., a Delaware company, became the ultimate holding company.

Australian operating entities include Canva Pty Ltd, Canva Operations Pty Limited, Canva Trading Pty Ltd and Fusion Books Pty Ltd. After 31 Dec 2024 the group restructured, and from FY25 Canva Australia Holdings Pty Ltd reports for the Australian group.

Freemium online design platform for individuals, teams and enterprises. Pricing runs from a free tier up to $100/month. Canva describes itself as moving from 'a design platform with AI tools' to an AI platform with agentic tools (Canva AI 2.0, launched April 2026).

Subscription tiers as of Sept 2024: Canva Pro for individuals at $120/yr. Canva Teams at $10 per person per month with a 3-person minimum, which took some US Teams customers from $119.99 to $500 per year.

Geography: most business comes from North America and international growth continues. Lower-priced subscriptions were introduced in Pakistan, Uruguay, Morocco and Jamaica. Named competitors: Adobe, Freepik, Apple.
Product scope is widening through M&A: Serif/Affinity (Mar 2024, about $380M), Leonardo AI (Aug 2024), MagicBrief (2025), Cavalry and MangoAI (Feb 2026), Simtheory and Ortto (Apr 2026).
Cavalry (UK 2D motion animation) and MangoAI (reinforcement learning for video-ad performance) acquired on undisclosed terms. Cavalry joins Affinity, now Canva's free professional design suite.

traction.claim: Company claim (COO Cliff Obrecht): more than 265M monthly active users at end of 2025, up 20%, and more than 31M paid users.
Company claim: business accounts with more than 25 seats grew 100% to $500M ARR (as of end-2025).

Company claim: users held more than 26M conversations with the Canva app inside ChatGPT by Oct 2025, and Canva is a top-10 domain referred from ChatGPT. LLM referrals are a double-digit percentage of traffic. Canva is also integrating with Claude.
Company claim: its AI mini-app/website builder (Canva Code) has more than 10M MAU.
Company claim: Affinity has been downloaded more than 5M times since it was made free in 2025.
Canva ranks as the third most used generative-AI web product by MAU, behind Google Gemini (a16z analysis cited by Fortune).
Company claim (CEO Perkins): Canva AI 2.0 users create 3x as many designs as on the previous version, and demand for the new AI features 'significantly exceeded' expectations.
Named customer example: Kimberfire (diamond-jewelry retailer). Its CEO said the AI features justified the higher Teams price so far.

team.claim: Co-founders: Melanie Perkins (CEO), Cliff Obrecht (COO) and Cameron Adams.

CFO Kelly Steckelberg started 26 Nov 2024 and is based in Austin, Texas. She was previously Zoom CFO (led its 2019 IPO), CEO of Zoosk, and worked at Cisco. Her predecessor Damien Singh stepped down about 9 months earlier after allegations of inappropriate behaviour, which Canva investigated.
Departure: CTO Brendan Humphreys (joined 2014) is stepping down in June 2026 and becoming an adviser. There is no direct CTO replacement. Simon Newton (ex-Google, Uber) becomes 'head of technology'.
Departure: head of design Andrew Green (joined Oct 2018) announced his exit less than a week after the Canva AI 2.0 launch. He stays on as an adviser.
Hire: Nirmal Govind (ex-Netflix VP Data Science & Engineering, MangoAI co-founder) became Canva's first Chief Algorithms Officer, and Vinith Misra (ex-Netflix, Roblox) also joined.

funding.claim: Jan 2018: raised A$40M from Sequoia Capital, Blackbird Ventures and Felicis Ventures at a A$1B valuation. May 2019: A$70M (reported US$2.5B valuation). Oct 2019: A$85M (reported US$3.2B valuation).

2021: raised US$200M at a US$40B valuation (last primary round found), backed by T. Rowe Price and Franklin Templeton. In 2022 T. Rowe wrote its mark down 44% and Franklin Templeton by as much as 60%.
Aug 2025: employee share sale valued Canva at US$42B. This is the last priced valuation found.
2026 fund marks: T. Rowe Price cut to US$38.2B (US$1,496/share) at end of the March 2026 quarter. Franklin Templeton cut to US$39.3B (US$1,541/share) by 30 June 2026.

Blackbird and AirTree marked Canva down 17%, from $42B to $34.9B. Canva's own independent internal valuation (used for employee share sales) fell from $38.9B to $31B. Neither mark reflects a transaction (AFR reporting, via TNW).
IPO: Canva has said it will list on Nasdaq, but timing is unclear. Obrecht said in May 2026 that Canva is targeting an IPO in 2027.

financial_signals.claim: Company claim: $4B ARR at end of 2025 (Obrecht).
Q2 2026 revenue was $921.9M, up 25.2% YoY and below internal guidance (AFR reporting, via TNW). Unaudited.

Canva cut its 2026 revenue growth forecast by a third, from 30% to 20%, after AI-serving costs came in higher than planned and the AI rollout was slowed. Company claim: cost per AI task down nearly 90% since April 2026.
Headcount: 5,500 employees in 2024 (AFR, cited by Wikipedia). Canva reached profitability in 2017 (TechCrunch 2018, cited by Wikipedia). No current profitability figure found.

Restructuring announced 4 Nov 2026: about 1,271 people (22% of staff) affected. CEO Perkins: 'our hardest year yet'; growth 'has slowed for the first time in a decade'. Product, growth and platform teams are being merged, and staff are moving to hybrid office attendance.

Severance: at least 6 months' pay, 12 months' healthcare where offered, the 1-year vesting cliff waived, and $10k grants for departing staff starting a business or project. The 1,271 figure covers layoffs, role changes and relocations, which implies total headcount of about 5,800 (my derived estimate).

legal_and_regulatory.claim: ASIC: four Australian Canva entities each paid a A$198,000 infringement notice (A$792,000 total) for allegedly missing the 30 Apr 2025 deadline for FY24 financial reports. The FY24 consolidated report was lodged on 27 Mar 2026. Payment is not an admission of liability. FY25 reports were lodged on time on 30 Apr 2026.

Patent suit: Cedar Lane Technologies Inc. v. Canva US, Inc. and Canva Australia Holdings Pty Ltd, W.D. Tex. No. 7:25-cv-00271 (35 U.S.C. §271). A magistrate's report and recommendation on Canva's motion to dismiss (5 Aug 2026) was adopted by order on 23 Sep 2026. The page does not show the full disposition.

Competing suits in LA County Superior Court with music-rights firm Crunch Digital. Crunch alleges breach of contract and says it was pushed out after raising 'potential licensing issues affecting Canva's operations'. Canva alleges Crunch disclosed confidential music-usage data to Pathfinder Royalties. No amounts disclosed.

Third-party breach: unauthorized access to Canny, a feedback tool connected to Canva's Salesforce, exposed some enterprise customer records (business contacts, routine business documents). Canva says its platform, user accounts, passwords and designs were not compromised. The Seven Deadly Sins group claimed on 16 Oct 2026 that it took more than 2M Salesforce records and sold them; this is unverified.

Türkiye's data protection authority (KVKK) said the Canny-linked breach affected 424 organizations in Türkiye. Exposed data included names, business emails, phone numbers, order forms, DPAs, MSAs and invoices. Its examination was ongoing as of 16 Sep 2026.
The attacker's October claim also cites more than 200M database rows, including corporate data-warehouse data. Canva had not responded to this later claim as of publication; it is unverified.

Historical: the May 2019 breach exposed data on about 139M users (names, emails, password hashes). In Jan 2020 about 4M passwords were decrypted and shared. A senior engineer's unfair-dismissal case was settled (AFR, Apr 2024).

reputation.claim: Customer backlash in 2024 over Teams price increases of up to 300%. Critics said this risked pricing out the small teams that drove word-of-mouth growth. Canva cited new AI features (Magic Studio) and four years without a price change.
Critical press: Canva faces growing competition from AI startups such as Gamma and from general-purpose chatbots (ChatGPT, Gemini) that can generate posters and presentations.

Critical analysis: a PitchBook analyst says AI makes SaaS 'no longer a zero marginal cost solution'. He groups Canva's growth slowdown with Figma's margin pressure and suggests the IPO is moving to 2027 to protect profitability.
The layoff handling and severance drew praise from industry commentators ('a master-class'), which may soften damage to the employer brand.

red_flags.claim: Growth is slowing: the 2026 growth forecast was cut from 30% to 20% on AI-serving costs, and CEO says growth slowed for the first time in a decade.
Valuation compression: the internal valuation fell to $31B and the Blackbird/AirTree marks to $34.9B, against the $42B last price.
Restructuring affecting about 22% of staff (1,271 people).
Governance and reporting: FY24 Australian financial reports were lodged about 11 months late, leading to A$792k in ASIC infringement notices. This is relevant to IPO readiness.
Vendor-linked breach of enterprise customer contracts and contacts. A regulator says 424 Türkiye organizations were affected, and an extortion group claims a much larger haul (unverified).
Senior technical and design leaders left in 2026 (CTO with no direct replacement; head of design).
Possible music-licensing exposure: the counterparty in active litigation alleges 'potential licensing issues affecting Canva's operations'.

output.verdict: Strong: Canva has very large scale and distribution (company-claimed $4B ARR, 265M MAU, 31M paid at end of 2025), its enterprise business doubled to $500M ARR, and it has deep AI and chatbot integrations plus an IPO-experienced CFO. Needs a closer look: growth was cut to about 20% on AI inference costs, investors marked the valuation down 7–26% from $42B, 22% of staff were cut, and the CTO and head of design left. Also check financial-reporting discipline (ASIC late-lodgement penalties), the Canny/Salesforce enterprise data incident, and the music-licensing dispute before relying on IPO-timing assumptions.
missing_fields: lead investor for each funding round (2019 and 2021 leads not confirmed on an opened page)
audited 2025 revenue, gross margin and current profitability
current total headcount (only the 2024 figure of 5,500 and a derived estimate of about 5,800)
current customer complaint patterns (Trustpilot or similar not opened)
named current enterprise customers and customer counts from Canva's own pages (canva.com returned 403)
final disposition of Cedar Lane v. Canva and other patent suits (DigiMedia, Cascade/HyperQuery not verified on opened pages)
Crunch Digital litigation filing dates and amounts
whether any class action has been filed over the 2026 Canny/Salesforce breach
outcome of the investigation into former CFO Damien Singh
